description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hiththatiya Central, Matara D/S/Division Matara District - Cad. Map No.820003
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land-related encumbrances. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, property extents, and legal conditions affecting the titles. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it primarily concerns land registration and property ownership matters.
